reason: The candidate action is a single tool call to get_product_details, compliant with the policy requirement of 'at most make one tool call at a time' and the prohibition on simultaneous user responses. The policy explicitly authorizes agents to 'provide information about...related products.' Nothing in the policy prohibits calling the same tool twice. This information-gathering step is appropriate and necessary before the agent can list modification details and request explicit user confirmation as required before executing a database-updating modification action.
policy_references: provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products
You should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time
